scientific_scope: post-forward-hypothesis development test of one new exact-tail distribution family; the family was motivated by C075-E's quarantined failure pattern but C075-C/E target labels are forbidden for fitting, scoring, parameter selection or gate tuning

source.reuse: exact C074-E parsing, same-date predict-before-update history, and both-team >=8 prior-result eligibility

estimand.population: eligible matches with realized exact total T>=7

candidate.positive_tail: for E>=1 define Y=E-1; rho=sum(Y)/(sum(Y)+n_positive) on the training fold

fold_rule: for each test season, fit both baseline and hurdle parameters only on eligible seasons with season_start strictly earlier than the test season

all_required: coverage gate passes before effect interpretation
paired bootstrap 90% upper bound for LogLoss delta < 0
at least 4 of 5 chronological folds have LogLoss delta < 0
maximum unenumerated tail residual for either family <=1e-8
frozen_pass_gate.decision: STOP_COVERAGE if coverage fails; SCIENTIFIC_COMPONENT_PASS_DEVELOPMENT_ONLY only if every required gate passes; otherwise FAIL_PARK

parameter_freeze_if_pass.fit_horizon: all eligible internal rows through 2023-24 only
parameter_freeze_if_pass.algorithm: same deterministic MLE pi and rho formulas above
parameter_freeze_if_pass.status: confirmation-ready research parameter only after development PASS; formal_weight remains 0

stopping_rule: after this OOS result, do not alter the hurdle definition, add covariates, smooth pi/rho, change folds, select leagues, alter coverage/gates or compare additional tail families on these scored internal OOS labels as a repair of C075-F
